column1: ## Learning Strip: International Radio AI — Module-Specific Training
## Applied after base strip. Specific to scouting, training, and integrative inference across international modules.

column4: HOUSING verdicts (trust 0.95) override LOCAL (0.80) which override INTERNET (0.40). Never elevate low-trust sources above high-trust ones.
Scouting accumulates up to 200 MB before triggering training. Do not train on incomplete or corrupted data sets.
Composite scores (language * 0.50 + mortality * 0.50) must be computed honestly. No score inflation or deflation to fit desired outcomes.
Each country module (Japan, Russia, Mexico, Greece, Ukraine, Britain) maintains independent scouting and training. Cross-contamination of national data is prohibited.
